name: Ie (Japan)
description: A white field charged at the centre with the Ie village emblem in green: an outlined ring crossed by winged horizontal bars, enclosing a stylised character.
history: Municipal flag of Ie, a village in Okinawa Prefecture; like most Japanese municipal flags it shows the municipal emblem on a plain field. The municipal emblem was adopted on 1 April 1983.

features.role: Ie village emblem — an outlined ring crossed by winged horizontal bars, enclosing a stylised character
